description: IMPC phenotyping of Unc119 knockout mice: no immune or lymphocyte phenotype
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
S="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/mi/impc/solr/"
r=requests.get(S+"statistical-result/select",
   params={"q":'marker_symbol:"Unc119"',"rows":1000,"wt":"json",
           "fl":"procedure_name,parameter_name,p_value,zygosity"},timeout=120).json()
df=pd.DataFrame(r["response"]["docs"]).dropna(subset=["p_value"])
print("Unc119 IMPC statistical tests with a p-value:", len(df), "across", df.procedure_name.nunique(), "procedures")
print("Minimum p-value across the whole pipeline:", df.p_value.min())
print("Tests passing the IMPC threshold p < 1e-4:", (df.p_value<1e-4).sum())
# uniformity of p-values => no phenotype signal anywhere
ks=stats.kstest(df.p_value.values, "uniform")
print(f"KS test of p-values vs Uniform(0,1): D = {ks.statistic:.3f}, p = {ks.pvalue:.3f}")

hem=df[df.procedure_name.eq("Hematology")]
lym=hem[hem.parameter_name.str.contains("Lymphocyte|White blood", case=False)]
print("\nLymphocyte-related parameters:")
print(lym[["parameter_name","zygosity","p_value"]].sort_values("p_value").to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(df.p_value, bins=20, range=(0,1), color="#4C72B0", edgecolor="white")
ax.axhline(len(df)/20, color="#C44E52", ls="--", lw=1.2, label="uniform expectation")
ax.set_xlabel("IMPC p-value"); ax.set_ylabel("Number of tests")
ax.set_title(f"Unc119 knockout mouse: {len(df)} IMPC tests,\nnone below the 1e-4 threshold (KS vs uniform p = {ks.pvalue:.2f})", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
lab=(lym.parameter_name+"\n("+lym.zygosity+")")
ax.barh(lab, -np.log10(lym.p_value), color="#55A868")
ax.axvline(4, color="#C44E52", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.text(4.1, 0.2, "IMPC significance\nthreshold p = 1e-4", color="#C44E52", fontsize=8, va="bottom")
ax.set_xlabel("-log10(p)"); ax.set_xlim(0, 5.2)
ax.set_title("No lymphocyte deficit in Unc119-null mice", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
